fullPassage: When you are creating your presentation, always ask yourself how technical you really need to be. An oral presentation is not going to be as effective or efficient as a written report in conveying technical facts. So if you want to convey raw data or lots of detailed information, consider pushing that material out of your presentation and into a handout or a document you can email out to your audience. Alternatively, offer to meet personally afterwards with those who are interested in the important details. Use your presentation to draw out the key conclusions or take-home messages, and invite the audience to find the extra detail elsewhere. If you want your audience to hear what you say, take it in and respond in the way you want them to, make them feel that you care about them and their needs.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: their __________ 구조에서 소유격 뒤 → 명사 필요. needy(형용사) → needs(명사). 또한 them and their needs에서 복수형 필요.
det.tip: 소유격(their) + 명사 자리 → needy(형용사) → needs(명사 복수)

questions.passage: When you are creating your presentation, always ask yourself how technical you really need to be. An oral presentation is not going to be as effective or efficient as a written report in conveying technical facts. So if you want to convey raw data or lots of detailed information, consider pushing that material out of your presentation and into a handout or a document you can email out to your audience. Alternatively, offer to meet personally afterwards with those who are interested in the important details. Use your presentation to draw out the key conclusions or __________, and invite the audience to find the extra detail elsewhere. If you want your audience to hear what you say, take it in and respond in the way you want them to, make them feel that you care about them and their needs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: take-home messages = (글, 경험, 수업 등에서) 얻을 수 있는 메시지[교훈]
det.analysis:
❌ ① technical details(기술적 세부사항): 발표 밖으로 빼야 할 내용
✅ ② take-home messages(핵심 교훈): key conclusions과 or로 병렬 ← 정답
❌ ③ personal opinions(개인적 의견): 본문 맥락과 무관
❌ ④ raw data(원시 데이터): 발표 밖으로 빼야 할 내용
det.tip: key conclusions or __________ → 핵심 결론과 병렬되는 핵심 메시지

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① refuse to engage(참여를 거부하다): 적극적 소통 맥락에 반대
❌ ② decide to avoid(피하기로 결정하다): 세부사항 관심자를 위한 대안 맥락에 반대
❌ ③ hesitate to contact(연락을 주저하다): 적극적 제안 맥락에 반대
✅ ④ offer to meet(만나겠다고 제안하다): 관심 있는 사람에게 개인적 만남 제안 ← 정답
det.tip: Alternatively, __________ personally afterwards — 대안으로 직접 만남을 제안하는 맥락
